mobile.title: Your thumbs are too small for this
mobile.description: The floor plan editor needs a real keyboard, a mouse, and ideally a cup of coffee. Come back on a computer and we'll let you rearrange the furniture.

title: Floor Plan
description: Arrange desks, walls, doors, and other objects to match the physical layout of your space.

canvas.emptyAddPrompt: Add desks or shapes from the panel on the right.
canvas.emptyShortcuts: Drag to reposition · click to select · <kbd>R</kbd> to rotate

view.title: View
view.combinedHelp: All rooms on one canvas. Pick a room to focus.
view.singleHelp: Pick which room to lay out.
view.noRooms: No rooms yet — add one in the Rooms page.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.help: Click to drop one onto the canvas. Drag once placed.

combine.title: Combine rooms on canvas
combine.description: This shows all rooms together on one canvas so you can lay out the full space. Desks stay linked to their original rooms — nothing changes in the calendar or bookings. You can switch back to split view at any time.

split.title: Switch to split view?
split.description: The floor plan will go back to showing one room at a time. Your layout is already saved — nothing will be lost.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.description: You have unsaved floor plan changes. Save them now, or leave and lose them.

modal.title: Floor Plan
modal.uploadHelp: Drag & drop or click to select. JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF up to 5MB.
modal.errorType: Please upload a JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF image.
modal.errorUpload: Failed to upload floor plan. Please try again.
modal.errorDelete: Failed to remove floor plan. Please try again.
